mechanism_narrative: The current level of the federal funds rate is inversely related to equity market returns; lower rates compress discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of observations, or the walk-forward Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and SPX 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4.5% per annum, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), or the walk-forward Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and SPX 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is rising (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) and consumer price inflation is above 3.0% (CPIAUCSL > 190.0), it indicates a dual threat of monetary tightening and high inflation, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0% AND CPIAUCSL > 190.0, or the walk-forward Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) and declining employment (PAYEMS < 132000.0), the market anticipates a recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5% AND PAYEMS < 132000.0, or the walk-forward Rank IC for the regime signal is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The current level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) is positively correlated with equity market returns; strong labor market conditions support consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of observations, or the walk-forward Rank IC between PAYEMS and SPX 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 2000.0 thousand units, it signals weak consumer demand and a potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (HOUST < 2000.0), or the walk-forward Rank IC between HOUST and SPX 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are below 2000.0 and retail sales (RSAFS) are below 340000.0 million dollars, it indicates a severe demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 2000.0 AND RSAFS < 340000.0, or the walk-forward Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 1.5% monthly) and strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 2.0% annualized), the economy is in a late-cycle expansion, often leading to overbought equity markets and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth rate > 1.5% monthly AND GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% annualized
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO growth rate > 1.5% monthly AND GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% annualized, or the walk-forward Rank IC for the regime signal is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
